note: Cached causal mask and position indices as module buffers to reduce per-step tensor allocations; improved throughput but not yet best.
Tried tying token embedding/output projection weights; diverged badly and reduced step throughput, reverted.
Tried LR warmup+cosine decay in fixed 300s budget; converged slower than constant LR, reverted.
Tried SwiGLU MLP with parameter-matched hidden size (8/3*embd); no gain vs GELU baseline, reverted.
Re-ran clean baseline (no caching optimizations) with typical execution settings for fair comparison.
Kept cached causal mask + cached position indices; throughput rose to 213 steps and achieved new best val_bpb.
Preconverted dataset tokens to int64 tensors on-device and batched evaluator forward passes; reduced Python/C++ tensor setup overhead and reached new best.
Tried replacing LayerNorm with RMSNorm for speed/efficiency; slightly worse final val_bpb, so reverted.
Tried contiguous getBatch views in evaluator to remove stack allocations; no gain in final val_bpb, reverted.
Disabled intermediate validation passes (final eval only) to spend budget on training steps; reached new best at higher step count.
Tried buffered metrics-file flushing to reduce I/O overhead; no improvement in final val_bpb, reverted.
Capped effective grad-accumulation to 4 micros on CPU for more optimizer updates per budget; large improvement over uncapped accumulation.
Further capped effective grad-accumulation to 2 micros; increased update count and achieved new best val_bpb.
Tried no gradient accumulation (1 micro); more steps but noisier updates and worse val_bpb than 2-micro cap, reverted.
Tried true device-batch training via contiguous getBatch in trainer/evaluator; far fewer optimizer updates and much worse val_bpb, reverted training-path batching.
Restored per-sample training path while keeping backend-aware CPU-host token storage; still below best 9.7823.
Removed hot-path bounds/wrap checks in Dataset::get to trim overhead; no improvement over best run.
